notes: Generated from the existing cat child sprite as the identity and anatomy source of truth
Child proportions use a smaller head-to-body ratio, longer torso, longer forelegs and paws, taller ears, and a longer tail than the baby stage
Rear-leg anatomy is tucked beneath the torso with only a small rear paw tip visible, and the tail starts clearly behind the rump
Four frames share one 128x128 logical grid and palette before 2x nearest-neighbor output
Frames use binary transparency and a maximum of 32 colors
The app renders the low sleeping child pose at 1.2x so its perceived growth remains larger than the baby stage
The sleeping loop uses frames 2-3-4-3-2 in app code
